text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Aargh, out of my way! Move, move, moooove!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Come demons, come serpents! No matter who 
stands in our way!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
With this once-in-a-lifetime mighty blade, 
I shall slice you down!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
O Clan of Silence! O foreign gunner! O 
resurrected Demon King! Hear my command—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: BLOW TO SMITHEREENS!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: This is...!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Truly... a castle-cleaving blow...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To leave behind a run for posterity." No 
Reason, who had aimed for just that, now 
for the first time—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—She cast aside future generations. In 
return, her brilliance was blindingly 
dazzling...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nowa-hahaha! My short-lived reign has 
finally arrived!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In talent and ability, you all may very 
well surpass me. However—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Seizing this moment right now is No 
Reason!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, besides, even if they call it a 
"three-day reign," it is by no means set 
in stone to last merely three days.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If you lot go soft, then I shall live on 
for another year, three years, five years 
more!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Like hell I'll hand it over. Not while 
this soul still burns—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Looking down upon the world from the 
castle keep is none other than I! 
Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "She was strong. Incredibly so..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Today, she was—a Samurai.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, so they got away. In that case, 
what lies ahead is—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let us entrust it. To my—ever-shifting 
destiny.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even her bitter rivals admitted their 
complete defeat, and then—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, Trainer. Though we won, it 
seems 'the dream is shattered.' However—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
From the ashes of a broken dream, a new 
one may yet be born. Even if that dream 
is—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Even if it were a dream with no tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the beginning, I was simply drawn to 
No Reason's way of life and walked 
alongside him...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether blooming or falling, a cherry 
blossom remains a cherry blossom. And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Better one massive ovation than a hundred 
victories. As long as there's that one 
moment that rocks the crowd to their core, 
that's all that matters."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, then let us march to the next battle, 
Trainer. For as long as my strength holds 
out.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Why do I run? Why am I this strong?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"When you have no future, why are you in 
such high spirits? And why are you by that 
one's side?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: You get it now, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Of course. There was only one answer.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed! If we team up, victory after 
victory is assured. In that case—who cares 
about the rest!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Let us rack up victory after victory, and 
keep on laughing!! Nyahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A fleeting brilliance. And a joy that 
exists... precisely because it is 
fleeting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason laughed heartily into the face 
of the future as she gallantly sped on 
ahead.
